senses.gloss: किर किर, अस्, m. (fr. 1. कॄ), a hog.

कीर कीर, अस्, m. a parrot; the country and
(pl.) the people of Kāśmīra; (अम्), n. flesh; [cf.
कीन.]
—कीर-वर्णक, अम्, n. a kind of perfume
(स्थौणेयक).
—कीरेष्ट (˚र-इष्˚), अस्, m., N.
of several plants; the tree Mangifera Indica; a species
of mountain Pīlū Ākhoṭa; another plant, = जल-
मधूक.
किरक, अस्, m. a scribe.

कीरक कीरक, अस्, m. gaining, obtaining;
a Buddha; a kind of tree.

किरण, अस्, m. dust, very small dust; a rein (?);
a ray or beam of light, a sun or moon-beam; the
sun; (आ), f., N. of a river.
—किरण-मय, अस्, ई,
अम्, radiant, bright, refulgent.
—किरण-मालिन्, ई,
m. the sun (having a garland of rays).
—किरणावली
(˚ण-अव्˚), f., N. of a work by Udayana; a commen-
tary by Dādābhāi on the Sūrya-Siddhānta.
—किर-
णावली-प्रकाश, अस्, m. title of a work.

किरत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, scattering, spreading;
lighting, shedding light.
किरि, इस्, m. a hog, = किटि.

कीरि कीरि, इस्, m. (fr. 2. कृ), Ved. grateful
or laudatory mention or remembrance; a poem, hymn,
praise; one who praises, a poet.
—कीरि-चोदन, अस्,
आ, अम्, Ved. exciting praise, exciting the praiser.
किरिक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. sparkling, beaming.
किर्याणी, f. a wild hog.
किर्याणी किर्याणी. See under किर.

किरात किरात, अस्, m., N. of a degraded
mountain-tribe, one of the barbarous tribes who in-
habit woods and mountains and live by hunting (the
Kirrhadæ of Arrian), having become Śūdras by their
neglect of all prescribed religious rites (they are also
regarded as Mlecchas); a savage; a pigmy, a dwarf;
a groom, a horseman; N. of a plant, a kind of gen-
tian [cf. किरात-तिक्त]; N. of Śiva, as a moun-
taineer opposed to Arjuna, the account of which is
the subject of the celebrated poem by Bhāravi called
Kirātārjunīya; (ई), f. a woman of the Kirāta tribe;
a woman who carries a fly-flap or anything to keep off
flies; an epithet of the goddess Durgā; a bawd, a
procuress; an epithet of the river Gaṅgā; the celes-
tial Gaṅgā or river of Svarga.
—किरात-तिक्त, अस्,
m. the plant Agathotes Chirayta, a kind of gentian;
also किरात-तिक्तक.
—किरातार्जुनीय, अम्, n. (fr.
˚त + अर्जुन), title of an artificial poem by Bhā-
ravi, describing the combat of Arjuna with the god
Śiva in the form of a wild mountaineer or Kirāta,
(this combat and its result is described in the Vana-
parva or third book of the Mahā-bhārata 1538-1664.)
—किराताशिन् (˚त-आश्˚), ई, m. an epithet of Garuḍa,
the bird of Viṣṇu (‘swallowing the Kirātas’).

किरातक, अस्, m. (at the end of compounds) the
warrior or mountain-tribe of the Kirātas; N. of a
plant, = किरात-तिक्त.

किराति, इस्, f. an epithet of the river Gaṅgā; [cf.
किराती.]

किरातिनी, f., N. of a plant, the Indian spikenard;
[cf. जटामांसी.]

किरारि किरारि, इस्, m., N. of a people; (a
various reading has विरारि.)

किरिकिच्चिका किरिकिच्चिका, f. a kind of musi-
cal instrument.

किरिटि किरिटि, n. the fruit of the marshy
date tree, Phœnix Paludosa.
किरिश किरिश, अस्, m., N. of a man.

किरीट किरीट, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (said to
be fr. rt. 1. कॄ), a diadem, a crest, a garland or any
ornament used as a crown, a tiara; N. of a metre of
four lines, each containing twenty-four syllables.
—कि-
रीट-धारण, अम्, n. wearing a diadem, assuming
the crown.
—किरीट-धारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, crowned, hav-
ing a tiara; (ई), m. a king.
—किरीट-मालिन्, ई, इनी,
इ, ornamented with a diadem.
किरीट; add — (अस्), m. a merchant, trader.

किरीटिन्, ई, इनी, इ, decorated with a diadem, crested,
crowned; (ई), m. a king; an epithet of Indra; one
of the attendants of Śiva; a N. of Arjuna.

किरोडाट्य किरोडाट्य, nom. P. किरोडाट्यति,
to cheat.

किर्मिर किर्मिर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. variegated;
[cf. किर्मीर below and कर्बुर.]

किर्मीर किर्मीर, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt.
1. कॄ), variegated; (अस्), m. a variegated colour;
the orange tree; N. of a Rākṣasa or goblin conquered
by Bhīma-sena; [cf. Gr. κιῤῥός]
—किर्मीर-जित्, त्, m.
or किर्मीर-निसूदन, अस्, m. or किर्मीर-भिद्, त्,
m. or किर्मीर-सूदन, अस्, m. or किर्मीरारि (˚र-अरि),
इस्, m. an epithet of Bhīma-sena, the enemy and con-
queror of the Rākṣasa Kirmīra.
—किर्मीर-त्वच्, क्,
m. or f. (?), the orange tree.

किर्मी किर्मी, f. a hall, a building, an apart-
ment; an image of gold, a figure of iron; the Palāśa
tree, Butea Frondosa.
कीर्मी कीर्मी, f. a house for straw (?).
किर्मीरित, अस्, आ, अम्, variegated, spotted.
कीर्ण, कीर्णि, &c. See s. v. at p. 231.

कीर्णि, इस्, f. scattering, throwing; covering, con-
cealing.
कीर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, what is scattered.

कीर्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being covered, bestrewed;
being scattered; being thrown at.
कीर्तन, कीर्ति, &c. See under rt. कॄत्.

कीर्तन, अम्, n. mentioning, repeating, saying,
telling, celebrating, praising; (आ), f. fame, glory.
कीर्शा कीर्शा, f., Ved. a species of bird.

कीर्तनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be mentioned, to be
named or repeated, to be celebrated or praised.

कीर्तन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, deserving to be mentioned,
to be related.

कीर्तयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, mentioning, relating, re-
peating, celebrating, praising.

कीर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, said, asserted; mentioned, re-
peated; known, notorious; celebrated, praised.
कीर्तितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be mentioned or praised.

कीर्तेन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. deserving to be named
or praised.

कीर्त्ति or कीर्ति, इस्, f. mention, making mention of,
speech, report; good report, fame, renown, glory;
Fame personified as daughter of Dakṣa and wife of
Dharma; extension, expansion, diffusion; light,
lustre; favour, approbation; sound; dirt, mud; one
of the Mātṛkās or personified divine energies of
Kṛṣṇa.
—कीर्त्ति-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, conferring fame.
—कीर्त्ति-धर, अस्, m., N. of a copyist.
—कीर्त्ति-
प्रताप-बल-सहित, अस्, आ, अम्, attended with
fame, majesty, and power.
—कीर्त्ति-भाज्, क्, क्, क्,
receiving fame, celebrated, famous; (क्), m. an
epithet of Droṇācārya, the military preceptor of the
Pāṇḍus and Kurus.
—कीर्त्ति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, praised,
famous, celebrated; (आन्), m., N. of one of the
Viśva-devās; a son of Uttāna-pāda and Sūnṛtā; also
a son of Vasu-deva and Devakī; also a son of
Aṅgiras.
—कीर्त्ति-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of
fame.
—कीर्त्ति-रथ, अस्, m., N. of a prince of the
Videhas, a son of Pratīndhaka; also called कृत्ति-
रथ as son of Prasiddhaka.
—कीर्त्ति-रात, अस्, m.,
N. of a prince of the Videhas, a son of Mahāndhraka.
—कीर्त्ति-वर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a prince.
—कीर्त्ति-
वास, अस्, m., N. of an author.
—कीर्त्ति-शेष, अस्, m.
death (the leaving behind of nothing but fame); [cf.
आलेख्य-शेष, नाम-शेष, यशः-शेष.]
—कीर्त्ति-
सेन, अस्, m., N. of a nephew of Vāsuki, the serpent-
king.
कीर्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be praised or celebrated.
